children: Austin, Texas, United States, September 2nd, 2026, FinanceWire

announced completion of a new law enforcement doctrine and training methodology designed to operationalize de-escalation using the BolaWrap(R) 150, which ATF Ruling 2026-2 classified as an instrument of restraint rather than a firearm or “any other weapon.” The company has submitted the curriculum for independent validation in preparation for applying for California Peace Officer Standards and Training (“POST”) certification, with the methodology designed to address encounters in which verbal de-escalation is insufficient but circumstances do not yet require a traditional weapons-based response.

If certified, WRAP intends to integrate the methodology into patrol and crisis-response training and subsequently deliver it digitally through Wrap Tactics(TM). The company believes combining standardized doctrine, certified training, technology and digital delivery could reduce barriers to BolaWrap adoption, support recurring training and cassette revenue and provide a model for pursuing additional state certifications and agency adoption nationally.
To view the full press release, visit https://ibn.fm/zjvWf

Wrap Technologies, Inc. is a global public safety technology company delivering intelligent detection, orchestration and response solutions designed for the next generation of intelligent, human-centered public safety. The Company’s WrapShield(TM) platform unifies detection, orchestration and response into an integrated, human-supervised architecture spanning law enforcement, homeland security, defense, enterprise and critical infrastructure customers. Powered by the BolaWrap(R) 150, Wraptor MX(TM), WRAP Reality(TM), the WrapTactics(TM) learning management system and Frenel TPiCore(R) polarimetric sensing, WRAP builds on the principle that technology and trained human judgment must advance together. For Humans, By Humans. WRAP is headquartered in Miami, Florida. For more information visit www.wrap.com.
